text:
deploybot: Tag created: v3.5.0-rc1 (commit ab12cd34). Envs: staging, canary-eu, prod.

deploybot: Changelog summary:
- improved kernel selection heuristics for mixed-seq workloads
- fix: KV cache invalidation for long-context requests
- autoscaler: reduced flapping by increasing debounce window
- docs: `generate` param rename -> `output_mode`

deploybot: Tag pushed to repo: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood-inference/commit/ab12cd34

celeste: Thanks — kicking off staging smoke. Running quick rerun of text-gen and embeddings tests.

omar: Plan: start canary in eu-west-1 at 10:00 UTC, 5% traffic, monitor for 30m, then ramp to 20% over 10m if all good.

sre-oncall: I'll watch p50/p95 latency + 5xx rate. Alerting thresholds: p95 > 300ms or 5xx > 0.5% -> escalate.

marie: Ops request: please pin dedicated pools to `v3.5.0-rc1` after canary passes. Need predictable throughput for the next 24h.

paul: Rollback guidance: if we see regressions, run `scripts/releases/rollback.sh --tag v3.4.6` or use Console -> Releases -> Rollback on the tag page.

release-manager: Scheduled rollout window: 10:15–11:00 UTC. Canary first in EU, then US west. Hold window 30m after full rollout.

celeste: QA checklist posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INF-350. I started canary at 10:02 UTC; smoke looks fine so far.

deploybot: Canary started: canary-eu (5% traffic). Monitoring hook: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/abc123/canary-views

sre-oncall: Noted. Will enable verbose traces for the canary group for first 15m.

omar: Heads-up: KV cache warm-up may cause transient p95 spikes on initial ramp — recommend keeping ramp slow (5% -> 10% over 5m -> 20% over 10m).

celeste: Acknowledged. Adjusting ramp plan accordingly.

ops-oncall: Pinned `model-serving` to commit `ab12cd34` on dedicated-pool-3; added comment in infra ticket #4321.

paul: Final changelog blurb for release notes:
- runtime: smarter kernel selection for heterogeneous sequences
- reliability: fix for KV cache invalidation under long contexts
- infra: autoscaler debounce tuned to prevent oscillation
- api: param rename and docs updates

release-manager: If all green at 10:45, we proceed to full rollout. If any red flags, trigger rollback and notify #incidents.

celeste: All green at 10:48. Proceeding to ramp to 100% over next 20m.

deploybot: Release tag v3.5.0-rc1 documented and pinned where requested. Closing thread unless rollback is needed. :shipit:
